name: Geoplanetical Fire Performance Mod
description:
Made this mod for my laptop (8GB RAM / integrated graphics) to get playable FPS and make Speed 3 actually fast, but it works on high-end PCs too!

WHAT IT DOES:
- Massive FPS boost (removes heavy 8K textures, 3D clouds/atmosphere lag, and UI blur)
- Turbo Speed 3 (>>> runs way faster at ~16 days/sec, and the date counter keeps ticking smoothly)
- Press F10 in-game anytime to switch between FIRE mode and normal Vanilla graphics/speed

HOW TO INSTALL (1-Time Setup):
Because Steam Workshop only loads flags/images by default, you need to run the installer once so it can patch the game engine:
1. Close Geoplanetical.
2. Go to your Steam Workshop folder for this mod:
   Steam\steamapps\workshop\content\940230\<mod folder>
   (Or right-click Geoplanetical in Steam -> Manage -> Browse local files, then go up to steamapps\workshop\content\940230)
3. Double-click Install-Mod.bat and wait a few seconds until it says Done.
4. Start the game! You will see 'FIRE [F10]' and your FPS in the top-right corner.

HOW TO UNINSTALL / TURN OFF:
- Press F10 in-game, or turn the mod off in the Mods menu to go back to normal vanilla.
- Or run Uninstall-Mod.bat in the folder to restore the original files.

UPDATE v1.4.0:
- Updated for Game v1.0.9
- Fixed the "'node' is not recognized" error in Install-Mod.bat (you do NOT need Node.js installed anymore!)
